Commentary.Commentary: Update 2130 Local (1030 GMT) - The Australian players are out on the field and getting warmed up. The revised target for South Africa - 98 off 13 overs.

Update 2128 Local (1028 GMT) - Good news for all cricket fans as the rain has eased off and the covers are coming off. Let's hope that the game resumes soon with the cut-off time being just 21 minutes away. Race against time!

Update 2115 Local (1015 GMT) - It is still pouring down and the latest news that has come in is that the cut-off time for this match is 2149 Local (1049 GMT). If the match does not resume by then, South Africa will go through to the final as they have topped their group. The Australians will be hoping that the showers stop and they can have their future in their own hands. If the match does resume, the DLS target for a 10-over game is 79 runs. Everything is in the hands of the weather gods now!

Rain... South Africa... Knockout... DLS method - Connect the dots and you know best! The covers are on at the moment but we are hopeful of getting the run chase underway soon. Do keep in mind, we require at least 10 overs in the second innings to get a result. Stay tuned for latest updates...

Nadine de Klerk is down for a quick interview. Says that she came to know early in the morning today that she might play in this game. Adds it was discussed that she would bowl in the middle overs. Shares that the surface was not too bad and states that the girls bowled really well. Mentions that she is happy and excited that the girls have restricted Australia to this score on such a good batting track. Feels that with the dew around and their openers in good form, they are confident about chasing this total down. Tells that they have a very good team and a very good vibe in the group and they believe they can go all the way in this tournament.

After all the uncertainty regarding this match, we finally got underway. Australia were invited to bat first by Dane Van Niekerk and the hosts got off to a strong start. Meg Lanning and Beth Mooney then took it forward and the Aussies looked to be in control. However, the Protea bowlers bounced back by picking wickets at regular intervals to peg the opposition back. The selection of Nadine de Klerk for this crunch game turned out to be the masterstroke as she ably replaced the injured Marizanne Kapp and hunted down the wickets of Mooney, Gardner and Rachael. The touring team bowled with a lot of discipline in the middle overs to maintain a strong grip. Had the stumping chance of Meg Lanning not missed, this total could have been a lot lesser. Will that come back to haunt them?

A decent recovery by Australia to put up a respectable total on the board. They were reeling at one stage after losing four wickets near the halfway mark for only 71. The presence of their skipper, Meg Lanning, though enabled them to form a couple of vital partnerships and that has zoomed their total to 134!
Full delivery on middle, Lanning whips it to the deep mid-wicket for a single. AUSTRALIA END ON 134/5. It has started raining a bit as the players walk back to the dugouts. The covers are coming on.
Full on middle, Lanning flicks it to the deep mid-wicket for a couple. Good running.
Full on middle, Carey drives it towards long on for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, Carey looks to heave it away but misses.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! Full delivery outside off, Lanning drives it to covers and takes off for a single. Carey obliges at first and then goes back a little. She then spots Lanning calling her for a single and decides to respond. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Had she hit, Carey was a goner. Chetty does really well to collect the ball.
Khaka starts the over with a full ball just outside off, Carey drives this one down to long on for a single.
Another short one on middle, Carey looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes over the bowler's head. The batters take a single, before the fielder cleans it up.

Lucky! Very lucky! Short ball on middle, Lanning looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes up in the air. The bowler and the keeper try coming after it but the ball falls safely just near the stumps. A single.
Full delivery on the pads, Lanning looks to heave it to the leg side. She misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to short third man and both the batters cross for two leg byes!
Length ball on off, Lanning pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Short ball on middle, Carey pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, Carey looks to heave it away but fails to get any bat on it.
Shabnim Ismail (3-0-17-0) is back on to bowl the penultimate over.
FOUR! Excellent way to end the over. Low full toss on off, Lanning creams the drive through the cover region and picks up a boundary. 17 off the over, just what Australia needed.
Wide! Full delivery down the leg side, Lanning looks to flick but misses. Another wide.
FOUR! Poor bowling! Slower full toss on middle, Lanning makes room and then waits for it. She lifts it towards the deep cover region for a boundary.

FOUR LEG BYES! Valuable runs for Australia! Slower delivery down the leg side, Lanning looks to play it to the leg side but gets hit on the pads. The ball goes to the fine leg region for four leg byes.
Fullish outside off, Carey eases it down to long off for a run.
Full on middle, Lanning drives it to long on for a single.
LEG BYE! Good length ball on the pads, Carey looks to flick but misses again to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls to point and the batters steal a leg bye.
WIDE! Full delivery down the leg side, Carey looks to flick but misses. Wide signaled.
Ayabonga Khaka is back on. 2-0-11-1, her figures so far.
Full on middle, Carey flicks it to mid-wicket for a single. 4-0-19-3, what a spell! She came in as a replacement for Marizanne Kapp and has aptly filled in for her!
Good length ball on off, Lanning guides it towards the point region for a single.

NOT OUT! A big inside edge! Poor review from the Proteas. Good length ball on middle, Lanning looks to defend but it seems to have gone off the inside edge onto the pads. De Klerk and the rest put in an appeal but the umpire is unmoved. They immediately go for the review. The replays roll in and they show that there is a big inside edge on that one. Lanning is safe and sound!

Review time! Australian skipper, Meg Lanning, is the batter in question. She has been adjudged not out by the umpire but South Africa have challenged the decision regarding the lbw. Replays roll in and show a massive inside edge.
Good length ball on off, Carey drives it to deep cover for a single.
Length ball on the pads, Carey looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Nicola Carey is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Slower ball does the trick and Nadine de Klerk gets her third. She is having a brilliant game. De Klerk bowls this on middle, Haynes makes room and then looks to heave it away. She misses though but Nadine does not as the ball goes onto hit the stumps. The bowler is excited and rightly so.
Nadine de Klerk is back on to bowl her final over. 3-0-16-2, her figures so far.
Short on middle, Haynes pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Good running. Flighted ball on middle. Haynes dances down and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple. The fielder throws it to the keeper but the batter had made her crease easily.
On middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single. 100 up for the hosts.
Short ball on middle, Haynes plays it to the deep mid-wicket region for another run.
Floated on off, Lanning drives it to long off for a single.

Excellent fielding! Flighted ball outside off, Haynes drives it uppishly towards the deep cover region. Van Niekerk runs after it and dives forward to stop the ball from reaching the ropes. Three taken.
On off, punched to cover. After 15 overs, Australia are 94/4.
Flatter one on middle and leg, Haynes dances down the track and flicks it to square leg for a single.
Flatter one on middle, Lanning defends it to point and takes a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot from Lanning! Floated outside off, Lanning comes down the pitch and lifts it over the cover fielder for a stunning boundary.
Floated on the pads, Lanning looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
Floated delivery on middle and leg, pushed down to long on for a single.
Nonkululeko Mlaba is back on. 2-0-11-1, her figures so far.
Punched off the back foot by the batter to covers. Yet another quiet over, Australia are 87/4! 87, hmmm... devil's number!
On middle, pulled to the leg side for another run.
Short ball on middle, Lanning pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle, Lanning pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Lanning plays it late and guides it behind backward point for a couple.

Stumping chance missed! Chetty is not having a good evening! First a dropped chance and now a stumping. Tryon dishes a full delivery down the leg side, Lanning dances down and looks to flick but misses. Chetty fails to collect the ball, allowing Lanning to make it back to her crease. Will she make the Proteas pay for it?
Floated on middle, Haynes comes down and flicks it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball around off, pushed towards point. South Africa applying relentless pressure.
WIDE! Fullish ball down the leg side, Lanning looks to heave it to the leg side but fails to get any bat on it.
Play and a miss! Short ball outside off, Lanning looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.
Full delivery on off, Lanning defends it to point where Lizelle Lee makes a good stop. No run.
Good length ball on middle, Haynes flicks it to mid-wicket and takes off for a single. The fielder runs ahead and throws it to the stumps but misses. Would not have mattered though.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around middle and leg, Haynes ducks under it.

Appeal turned down! Ismail dishes a full delivery on the pads, Haynes looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Shabnim roars in an appeal but the umpire is not interested. Missing leg stump probably.
Shabnim Ismail is back into the attack. 2-0-15-0 are her figures so far.
On off, punched to the long off region for a single. 5 runs come off the over. Extremely slow going for the hosts as they are trying to recover.
Tossed up on off, Lanning looks to drive but gets an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Flighted on middle, Haynes plays a reverse paddle towards short third man. Only a single.
Full on middle and leg, Lanning works it towards deep square leg. They think of a couple but decide against it. A single taken eventually.
The batter has flicked the ball off her pads. They pick up a single.
Tryon starts with a flatter ball on middle, Haynes pushes it back to the bowler.
Chloe Tryon is into the attack now.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Haynes tucks it to backward square leg to keep strike for the next over.
Full on off, Lanning drives it through mid off for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Lanning cuts it to the point fielder.
Good length ball on the pads, Haynes flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Rachael Haynes is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another one bites the dust and Nadine de Klerk is on fire at the moment. Two wickets for her in back-to-back overs. She dishes a full delivery outside off, Gardner looks to drive without moving her feet and gets a thin outside edge towards the keeper. Chetty, this time, makes no mistake. The Proteas start celebrating and the finger goes up. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that there was a very faint outside edge.
Length ball around off, Lanning guides it to third man for a single.
Flatter one outside off, Gardner punches it off the back foot towards point. 70/3 at the halfway mark!
Short on middle, Lanning pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Lanning dances down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter one outside off, Lanning pushes it to the cover region.
Floated on off, Lanning defends it out.
Ashleigh Gardner is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shabnim Ismail takes the catch and Jess Jonassen departs early on in her innings. Floated delivery on the middle and leg pole, Jonassen steps down the track looking to go over the fielder at long on. She does not time it perfectly though and Ismail takes an easy catch running in from the deep. South Africa roaring in this match.
Nonkululeko Mlaba (1-0-10-0) returns in action.
Full on middle, Lanning pushes it back to the bowler. Successful over from Nadine de Klerk comes to an end.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.

An appeal for LBW turned down. Good length ball on the pads, Jonassen looks to flick but misses. She gets hit on the pads and the bowler puts in an appeal for LBW but the umpire turns it down. Very optimistic. Going down the leg side even to the naked eye.
Jess Jonassen is the new batter in, replacing Beth Mooney. Promotion?

OUT! TIMBER! The dangerous Mooney goes and de Klerk provides the breakthrough. A budding stand is broken. De Klerk bowls a good length ball on the pads, Mooney dances down the track and then looks to flick but the ball passes between the pad and bat. The ball goes on to uproot the leg stump. Mooney was looking good but now she has to depart. De Klerk is all pumped up!
Well timed! Full delivery outside off, Lanning drives it crisply through the covers but there is a fielder stationed in the deep. Only a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Back of a length ball on middle, Lanning rocks back and pulls this towards square leg for a boundary.
Full on middle, Lanning sweeps it to deep square leg to keep strike for the next over.

SIX! Right from the middle! Lovely timing from the Aussie skipper! Tossed up ball outside off, Lanning dances down the track and lifts it over the long off fielder for a biggie. She is all class and elegance!
Flighted ball outside off, Lanning drives it towards the deep cover region for a couple.

A bit of indecision! Floated on middle, Lanning looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side and Mooney wants the single but Meg sends her back. Van Niekerk picks up the ball and then has a shy at her end but misses. The dive probably would have saved her.
Short ball outside off, Mooney punches it wide of long off for a single.
Floated on off, Mooney dances down the track and then flicks it but cannot go past the mid-wicket fielder.
Fullish ball on middle, Lanning defends it out. 5 from de Klerk's first over.
Length ball on middle, Beth tucks it towards square leg for a single.
WIDE! Full delivery down the leg side, Mooney looks to flick but fails to get any bat on it. Wide signaled.
On middle, Meg blocks it to the cover region and takes a quick single.
Good length ball outside off, Lanning guides it down to the third man region. Khaka comes across and cleans it up. Two taken. 50 up for the hosts.
Full delivery outside off, Lanning pushes it to the point fielder.
Good length ball on middle, Mooney flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Nadine de Klerk comes into the attack after the completion of Powerplay.
Tossed up ball on off, Mooney defends it to cover and takes a single. 48/1 after the Powerplay! Good one for the Aussies.
FOUR! Nicely played! Mooney converts this ball into a full toss and creams her drive through the extra cover region for a boundary.
Flatter one around off, Lanning pushes it to the deep cover region for a single.
OHH! Much better from van Niekerk! Flights this one outside off, Lanning looks to defend but gets an inside edge, onto the pads.
Loopy one on middle, Beth pushes it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery to start from the skipper! She tosses this one down the leg side, Mooney bends on her knees and then sweeps it to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Bowling change. Dane Van Niekerk brings herself into the attack.
On a length outside off, Lanning gets off the mark by guiding this down to the third man region for a couple. A successful over comes to an end from Khaka.
Wide! Down the leg side, Lanning looks to flick but fails to get any bat on it. Wide signaled.
Length ball on off, Lanning defends it to point off the front foot.
Meg Lanning, the skipper, is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Massive blow! Healy does not last long after the drop from Chetty. Fullish delivery on middle, Healy flicks it uppishly towards mid-wicket. Dane van Niekerk hops up in the air and takes the catch safely inside the ring. Healy has got Australia off to a start. Not much reaction from the skipper, like the one she showed during the dropped catch. 100th international wicket for Khaka!
Fullish delivery on the off stump line, Mooney uses her feet and pushes it towards the mid off region for a single.
Slower delivery on off, Mooney defends it towards the point region.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet! Full delivery outside off, Mooney dances down the track and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Change of ends for Ayabonga Khaka.

DROPPED! Mlaba gives this one extra flight and serves it a little short and close to off. Healy moves back to cut but gets a fat outside edge. Trisha Chetty, the keeper, fails to hold onto it and Alyssa gets a life. 11 from the over, the Aussies are picking the pace now.

FOUR! Smashing shot again from the blade of Alyssa Healy. She is yet again showing strong form. Uses her feet to get to the pitch of the ball and blazes it past the bowler for a boundary at long off. That reached the fence in the blink of an eye.
FOUR! Boom! Tossed up ball around middle and off, Healy skips down the track and powers it over mid on for a cracking boundary.

Mlaba is busy shouting for an lbw and the batters cross! Given as a leg bye. Flighted and around leg, turning down, Mooney advances down the track to flick but misses. She wears it on her pads, Mlaba appeals but the umpire shakes her head. Going down.
Good field set! Flighted and full around off, Healy jumps down the track and drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted full ball around off, Mooney eases it with gentle hands towards backward point and takes a run.
Spin time! Nonkululeko Mlaba is into the attack.
Fantastic response from the pacer! She digs in a well-directed short ball, Healy tries her best to pull but fails to connect. Good contest, 9 runs from the over!

FOUR! What a shot! Power from Alyssa Healy. Ismail angles in a fuller length ball around off, Healy finds that in her zone and bludgeons it through mid off. The fielder reacts to her right but has no chance of cutting it off.
Brisk run. Back of a length ball on middle, again on the slower side, Beth drops it with soft hands in front of square leg for a single.
Beaten! Ismail senses the charge and sends across a slower full ball wide outside off, Mooney ends up pushing and missing.
FOUR! Up and over mid on! Back of a length delivery around off, Mooney rocks back and pulls it over the in-ring fielder for a boundary. Not a very good connection but enough to take it over.
Fullish delivery on middle, Mooney gets forward and defends it to the off side. Ismail runs across to her right to collect the ball.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length delivery outside off, Healy winds up for a big heave across the line but fails to connect. 3 from the over, a tidy one by Khaka!

Slower one, on a length close to off, Beth plays it with soft hands towards short extra cover and rushes to the other end. The fielder has a shy but misses. The back-up fielder fumbles and no extra run taken.
Beaten this time! A bit of a movement off the surface for Khaka. She pitches it up and outside off, inviting the drive, Mooney obliges but gets beaten by the movement.
Fails to find the gap! Too full and wide outside off, Mooney reaches out with the drive but picks out the cover fielder.
An off pace delivery, a touch on the shorter side outside off, angling away, Beth taps it down towards cover-point.
Shot! It's a loopy full ball by a medium pacer. Khaka serves it wide outside off and Mooney drills her drive past the diving extra cover fielder. Two runs taken.
Ayabonga Khaka will bowl from the other end.
Shabnim angles in a good length ball on middle and leg, Mooney eases it off her pads to deep square leg for one. 6 from the first over!
Quick running. A length ball shaping back into the batter, Healy works it to the right of mid on and steals a brisk run.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! Back of a length delivery outside off, plenty of width available, Alyssa latches onto it and smashes it over covers to open her account.
Shortish and on middle, coming slowly off the surface, Healy plays a mistimed pull shot towards mid-wicket.

Shout for an lbw! Turned down. Ismail gets a fuller length ball to nip back in from around off, Healy fails to flick and gets rapped on the pads. The appeal is not entertained as it seems to be going down the leg side.
Play and a miss! Ismail delivers it on a length outside off, Healy goes hard at it but fails to middle her shot. That almost kissed the outside edge. Excellent start for South Africa!

The longgggggg wait for a game today is over! Time to get underway! No national anthems. The South African ladies are taking the field. Beth Mooney and Alyssa Healy make their way out as the openers for Australia. Shabnim Ismail will start with the ball for South Africa. One slip in place...
Pitch report - Good covering of grass, a bit on the darker side but it should come nicely onto the bat. Bowl first and maybe get the most out of the conditions appear to be the best option.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Dane Van Niekerk (C), Lizelle Lee, Nadine de Klerk (IN FOR MARIZANNE KAPP), Chloe Tryon, Mignon du Preez, Sune Luus, Laura Wolvaardt, Trisha Chetty (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka, Nonkululeko Mlaba.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Ashleigh Gardner, Meg Lanning (C), Rachael Haynes, Sophie Molineux (IN PLACE OF ELLYSE PERRY), Delissa Kimmince (IN PLACE OF ANNABEL SUTHERLAND), Jess Jonassen, Nicola Carey, Georgia Wareham, Megan Schutt.

Australian skipper, Meg Lanning, says that she was not too sure what to do with some more rain expected. Feels that it's a really good pitch and hopes to make the most of it. Informs about the couple of changes - Ellyse Perry and Annabel Sutherland are replaced by Sophie Molineux and Delissa Kimmince.

South African skipper, Dane Van Niekerk, says that they are bowling with the rain around as you know better what to do in a semi-final. Adds that they have to be really good today. Mentions that they have to beat the reigning champions if they want to get to the final. Informs about the only change -  Marizanne Kapp has not recovered from her injury and is replaced by Nadine de Klerk.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it comes down in favour of Dane Van Niekerk. SOUTH AFRICA WILL FIELD!

FINALLY SOME CRICKET! It was a damp squib in the first semi-final but the conditions have improved a lot since then and we are lucky enough to have a game. Australia will be desperate to get on the field and have their destiny in their own hands as in case of a washout, South Africa would have qualified for the final. Hello and welcome everyone and thanks for being patient with us. The best part is that we have not lost any overs. Toss coming up in a bit...
